automation_handoff: Earlier Sol testworker turn was rejected by automated review before work; no test execution or failed runtime attempt has been replaced or hidden. This package implements the bounded local source task only.
decision: Focused cancellation reproduction and separate validator accuracy correction only; no production shutdown change or unchanged WAN retry justified.
fixed_gates: No changes to no-error, resource, ownership, natural-closure, performance or final-evidence gates.
limitations: Uses existing synthetic TCP snapshot fixtures and net.Pipe. Does not reproduce a kernel RawConn.Control error.
Explicit GoAway is a chosen header-only test stimulus, not attribution of the preserved WAN 34-byte record.
Forcing physical close completion while the observer remains active intentionally preserves existing close_race/ambiguous/invalid flags, which differ from tiny2 scheduling.
Session.Close return plus retirement proves existing send/receive/publisher completion-channel contract and Close waiting for ping replies; it is not runtime enumeration of every goroutine.
No performance, throughput, congestion-control-change or WAN-causality claim.
Source-only; not yet compiled or tested.
open_questions: Exact tiny2 plaintext frame and scheduling remain unknown.
Observer contribution to overlap remains unmeasured.
A guaranteed error-free close would need an established bounded shutdown protocol, not this test fixture.
preserved_result: tiny-threshold-history-smoke-2 stays rejected; natural process joins and exact transfers do not override final raw error gate.
production_fix_threshold: Require a demonstrated lifecycle contract violation: failure to join, retained ownership/resources after closure, or post-retirement activity. Expected interrupted control writes are insufficient.
rejected_workarounds: Waiting for send completion before physical close can deadlock a blocked peer.
Locks across observation/write/Close change cancellation semantics.
Snapshot drains, GoAway alone, endpoint stop-order swaps or idle sleeps do not prove quiescence.
Qualification-only drain barriers or repeat-until-pass runs would change or select the evidence.
source_findings: Yamux Session.Close closes its transport before joining send/receive loops, ping-reply worker and aggregate publisher.
Go 1.26.6 TLS Close intentionally interrupts an active TLS Write by closing its underlying connection.
Synchronous before/after TCP observation prolongs the TLS Write call. Perturbation is possible, causality is unproven.
Terminal agent-drain precedes stop-file cancellation and does not stop control producers or establish a no-future-write boundary.

tests.barrier: Raw Write waits for physical Close; after-capture waits until body Close has returned.
tests.expected: Raw write returns 0/error; failed after-capture retained; history inconclusive; natural Session.Close and fixture joins.

tests.barrier: Peer consumes the full explicit GoAway header and underlying Write returns; after-capture is held while body Close returns.
tests.expected: Raw write remains full success; after-capture failure remains unusable; natural Session.Close and fixture joins.

validator_scope: Independent worker owns correcting failed/uncaptured congestion-control comparison; no overlap in this package.
